# YT4MP3
> Free Online YouTube to MP3 and MP4 Converter & Media Guides

YT4MP3 is an independent, browser-based utility for converting YouTube links that you own, are licensed to use, or have permission to save into MP3 audio (up to 320kbps) and MP4 video files (when the source offers it).

## Core Features
- YouTube to MP3 converter with 320kbps, 256kbps, 192kbps, and 128kbps bitrate selection.
- YouTube to MP4 converter supporting 1080p, 720p, 1440p (2K), and 2160p (4K) resolutions when available from the source.
- Dedicated YouTube Shorts converter for vertical 9:16 MP4 or MP3 audio.
- Direct browser workflow with no software installation and no account registration required.
- Compatible with desktop and mobile browsers across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux in 15 languages.

## Available Pages
- [Home](https://www.yt4mp3.com/): Free Online YouTube to MP3 and MP4 Converter.
- [YouTube to MP3 Converter](https://www.yt4mp3.com/youtube-to-mp3): Convert permitted YouTube links into MP3 audio files up to 320kbps.
- [YouTube to MP4 Converter](https://www.yt4mp3.com/youtube-to-mp4): Convert permitted YouTube links into MP4 video files up to 4K when the source offers it.
- [YouTube Shorts Downloader](https://www.yt4mp3.com/youtube-shorts-downloader): Convert permitted YouTube Shorts into MP4 video or MP3 audio.
- [Blog & Technical Guides](https://www.yt4mp3.com/blog): Original tutorials on audio bitrates, video formats, mobile saving workflows, and copyright/Creative Commons compliance.

- [Copyright & DMCA Policy](https://www.yt4mp3.com/dmca-policy): Intellectual property compliance and DMCA takedown notice procedures.
